answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 65 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in ember, queued in fable, and garden publishes the wait time. A farm of 212 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4850 identities would post 3515 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
